name: Lagoon 52
description: Five double cabins, so nobody in the group ends up on a sofa bed, and a sixth cabin with bunk beds if you're bringing kids. The flybridge is where everyone gathers to watch the next island get closer. At the stern, a grill, an outside shower and a kayak ready to go in the water. Refitted in 2024.
